title: fix(plugin-grid): a finished import no longer says "Review data before importing." (objectui#13124)
body:
Fixes #13124

Clause-②: no

That line is copied verbatim from the claim. The delivered diff adds no string-table key and no export: no `grid.import.*` key in any language pack, so `@object-ui/i18n`'s `TranslationKeys` is untouched. Per the claim, the seat corrects the line to `no` at ACCEPT.

## What changed

`ImportWizard`'s dialog subtitle chose its text from `step` alone (`upload`, `mapping`, else `grid.import.previewDescription`), and a finished import keeps `step === 'preview'`. So the result screen read "Import Complete / 1 created / 1 skipped" under "Review data before importing.".

- On the result screen the header renders no `DialogDescription`.
- The result screen's own headline (`grid.import.importComplete`, or `grid.import.importCancelled`) is rendered as the dialog's `DialogDescription`. `RESULT_HEADLINE_CLASS` overrides the primitive's `text-sm text-muted-foreground`, so the headline looks as it did. The dialog's `aria-describedby` therefore names the finished state, and exactly one description is mounted in every state.
- The upload, mapping, preview and history subtitles are unchanged.
- No new key, export, prop or type member. One changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## How the shape was chosen (the dispatch's H1 to H4, measured)

**H1, every arm of the subtitle.** Read from the ternary and from every `setResult` site; no path that sets `result` moves `step`.

| state | step | result | subtitle before | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| upload | upload | none | uploadDescription | unchanged |
| mapping | mapping | none | mappingDescription | unchanged |
| preview | preview | none | previewDescription | unchanged |
| importing: sync, or a background job queued or processing | preview | none | previewDescription | unchanged (see Acceptance notes) |
| result, not cancelled: sync server import, legacy per-row, job succeeded or failed, 405 refusal, thrown failure | preview | set | previewDescription | header: none; description: the importComplete headline |
| result, cancelled | preview | set, cancelled | previewDescription | header: none; description: the importCancelled headline |
| history | upload | none | historyDescription | unchanged |

**H2, reuse vs add vs none.**

- Radix, measured: the only `@radix-ui/react-dialog` in `pnpm-lock.yaml` is 1.1.23. Its `DialogContent` sets `aria-describedby` only while a `Description` is mounted (`descriptionPresent`), and its dist has no `console.*` call, so no warning fires either way. The repo already treats a dialog without a description as an accessibility gap (the fullscreen editor's sr-only description, pinned by objectui#3404's test). So "none" alone would trade the stale sentence for an undescribed dialog; ablation leg B below shows exactly that.
- Reusing `importComplete` visibly in the header would print "Import Complete" twice, one line above the other.
- The chosen shape reuses the existing done-state keys as the description, prints nothing twice, and adds no key.

**H3, controls.** The upload, mapping and preview subtitles are pinned unchanged, each as the dialog's accessible description.

**H4, ablation.** Below.

## Tests

New: `packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.doneSubtitle-13124.test.tsx`, through the real wizard and a stubbed data source:

- controls: the upload, mapping and preview subtitles, each what `aria-describedby` names;
- a completed import (the card's repro, "1 created" and "1 skipped"): "Review data before importing." appears nowhere, and the description is the "Import Complete" headline, carried by exactly one element;
- a cancelled background import: the same, with "Import cancelled".

Expected copy is read by key from `IMPORT_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`, so a rewording moves the test with it.

Ablation: the fix was committed first; each restore is proven by the file's blob hash equal to HEAD's and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The test imports `./ImportWizard` relatively, so it reads `src/`; no `dist/` is involved.

- Leg A (H4): the whole `ImportWizard.tsx` reverted to the base commit `4c36eab`. 2 failed, 1 passed: the completed and cancelled cases find the header description "Review data before importing."; the controls pass.
- Leg B, the "none" shape (header subtitle dropped, the completed headline a plain paragraph again), through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0). 1 failed, 2 passed: the completed case finds no `aria-describedby` at all (`{ text: null, carriers: 0 }`).

Local runs, all at `041498e` (this PR's head):

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 40 test files that name `ImportWizard` or its result copy (derived with `git grep -l`): exit 0, Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 356 passed (356).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid lint`: exit 0, 0 errors; none of the file's existing warnings sits on a changed line.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test.
- Exit 0 each, verdict lines green: `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:control-bytes`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals`, `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:shell-escape-residue`, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- Not run locally: `pnpm check:i18n-drift` (no i18n key or value changes); the repo-wide `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

Observed, not changed here, not filed:

- While an import runs (sync, or a background job queued or processing), the subtitle still reads "Review data before importing." above the progress bar. Same subtitle-follows-step class, but the dispatch keeps the other steps' subtitles unchanged, and no importing-state sentence exists to reuse without a copy decision. Carrier: none.
- The step indicator still highlights "3. Preview" on the result screen. Carrier: none.
- An import that fails outright (405 refusal, thrown server failure, background job `failed`) shows the green check and the "Import Complete" heading. With this change that heading is also the accessible description, exactly as visible. Read from source, not measured through the console. Carrier: none.
